messages:
anna (PM): Quick sync — need to finalize scope & launch criteria for the enterprise compliance epic (audit logs, BYOK/KMS, SOC2 evidence, data retention). Sales pressure from a finance customer. Who's available?

mike (Security): I'm here. Two immediate asks: exportability of raw logs and BYOK. Also need clear retention windows.

lisa (Sales): Customer X explicitly asked for 7 years retention + BYOK. They said SOC2 or can't sign.

raj (Eng): 7 years raw logs is heavy. We can offer 7y for aggregated/hashed events and provide raw log export to customer S3 to satisfy e-discovery. Need to decide default vs opt-in.

anna (PM): Proposed default: 90d raw logs live, 7y aggregated audit records searchable, and raw-log export API to customer-managed storage for long-term retention (hosted/dedicated). MVP approach — thoughts?

sam (Legal): Export to customer-controlled S3 + BYOK good direction. Legal wants DPA appendix language and proof of export processes. Also add requirements for data deletion and e-discovery support.

mike (Security): BYOK must support AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault for hosted; Dedicated/Private can support HSM later. Launch criteria should include key rotation policy, least-privilege IAM docs, and threat model sign-off.

raj (Eng): Questions: do we do server-side encryption with customer keys (SSE-C/SSE-KMS) or encrypt at object level before upload? Also cost for long retention — will need a pricing SKU.

anna (PM): Quick list of launch criteria draft: 1) Audit log ingestion + query/streaming UI, 2) Retention config + export API, 3) BYOK integration (AWS/GCP/Azure) for object encryption, 4) SOC2 evidence pack generation & runner, 5) Runbooks + e2e tests, 6) Pricing & legal appendix. Anything missing?

lisa (Sales): Add: explicit SLA language for export jobs and delivery windows. Sales needs a commitment to give to the customer.

mike (Security): Add: pen-test sign-off for any path that handles customer key material. Also KMS access patterns documented.

sec-bot: Created INF-2215 "Compliance: BYOK + retention export" and assigned to @raj with label:priority-high.

raj (Eng): 6 weeks for a full BYOK + export that includes UI and SOC2 evidence automation is tight. If MVP limits to BYOK via customer-managed KMS (no HSM/import) + export API (signed PUT to customer bucket) we can do ~4 weeks. Full HSM/import + rotation UI = +6w.

anna (PM): Decision proposal for MVP: implement BYOK for hosted via KMS integration (support AWS/GCP/Azure KMS keys referenced by ARN/resource id), provide export API to customer buckets (signed jobs + optional KMS envelope), implement retention config UI (90d default) + long-term export option. Defer HSM/import & server-side key import to phase 2. Agree?

mike (Security): :thumbsup: I'll draft key handling policy and rotation/least-privilege checklist.

sam (Legal): Legal will draft the DPA appendix and retention/export contract language. Need example retention config and export contract text.

raj (Eng): Example retention config we'll prototype (for spec):
```
{
  "log_type": "audit",
  "retention_days": 2555, // ~7 years
  "export": {
    "enabled": true,
    "s3_bucket": "s3://cust-x-retain",
    "kms_key_arn": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcd-1234"
  }
}
```

lisa (Sales): I'll update the customer: MVP = BYOK via cloud KMS + raw export capability. HSM & certified SOC2 timeline in follow-up. They'll accept provisional commitment if we give dates.

anna (PM): SOC2 note: include evidence pack generation in MVP (logs, access reviews, rotation proofs) but formal audit/certification likely next quarter. We'll label external comms as "SOC2 readiness in progress; certification targeted for Q".

mike (Security): I'll start the threat model doc and add PR checklist entries to block merges until required controls are added.

raj (Eng): I'll break INF-2215 into subtasks (KMS integration, export API, retention UI, SOC2 evidence tooling, tests) and post estimates by EOD Friday.

anna (PM): Great. Action items: @raj -> tech spec + estimates by EOD Fri; @mike -> key policy + threat model by Thu; @sam -> legal appendix draft by Fri; @lisa -> customer comms draft after we have dates. We'll review Monday 10am. Thanks all.
